name: s7-s8-8b-diagnostic-preregistration
title: Addendum 2 to the S7-S8 preregistration: a minimal capability diagnostic of a larger local generator on the GOLD_KNOWN context, pinned by the SHA-256 of its private document
document_status: private; kept outside the public repository

design.question: is the bottleneck the capacity or obedience of the 4B generator even when the known relevant evidence is in its context
design.technical_adaptation: chat template with enable_thinking = false; same messages
design.decoding: greedy, max_new_tokens 900, fresh prompt cache per case, no content retries
design.baseline: the stored 4B GOLD_KNOWN outputs of the sealed evaluation, untouched

rule.new_systematic_failure: a failure type absent from all 18 outputs of the 4B that appears in 3 or more of the 18 outputs of the 8B

design.if_passed: a small blind cross-model audit of up to 40 claims with the same rubric and threshold; then stop and propose, never an automatic campaign

amendments: append-only: a later version is a new document with a new hash, published before it is used
note: The commit that adds this file is the public timestamp: the model, the decoding, the cases, the decision rule and the audit rule were fixed before any output of the larger model was generated.
